# Vendored libraries

- **gifenc.js** — gifenc 1.0.3 by Matt DesLauriers (https://github.com/mattdesl/gifenc), MIT, see `gifenc.LICENSE.md`.
  Source: npm `gifenc@1.0.3` `dist/gifenc.js` (CommonJS). Wrapped in an IIFE that sets `self.gifenc`, so it loads
  with `<script>` and `importScripts()` and works from file://. Source-map comment removed. No other changes.
